caption: The jump where Tom Cruise really broke his ankle is in Mission: Impossible – Fallout.

He hit the wall between two London rooftops, knew at once it was broken, and ran on so the shot would not need redoing (he told The Graham Norton Show). Director Christopher McQuarrie kept that take. Shooting stopped for 7-8 weeks, and he did the HALO jump 106 times, practice included.
